turns.question: Between 1 and 10 October 2026, how many euros less did a first-time buyer's order come to, on average, than a returning customer's?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no such metric: no metric or dimension splits orders into first-time buyers and returning customers, so I can't give that difference. The closest metrics are average_order_value_eur (average amount of a non-cancelled order, which can only be split by customer country, signup date or order status), revenue_repeat_customers_eur and repeat_revenue_share (revenue from customers with two or more orders in all, which is not the same as returning at the time of the order), and repeat_customers.
